name: NordPass
description_en:
NordPass is a product in the Password management category. Its directory profile covers Password Generator, Secure Password Sharing, Multifactor Authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Third-party Integration, Password Encryption, Saved Cards, Mobiles Password Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Websites Password Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $2.49. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create passwords using configured requirements; use a shared identity provider for application sign-in. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
NordPass 属于密码管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括密码生成、安全密码共享、多因素验证、单点登录、第三方集成、密码加密、保存支付卡信息、移动设备密码管理。

资料还列出网站密码管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $2.49. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。
